result.brief: 通过预注册实验检验JEPA与自编码器潜空间是否编码流体物理量，并提出路由式可操控方向（"旋钮"），揭示潜变量内容与可控性之间的分离。
result.reason: Pre-registered tests of whether JEPA/autoencoder latents organize physical quantities and support steerable directions in fluid dynamics; directly probes self-supervised video/world-model representation structure.
